category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, bound the existing standardized training-frequency input with 2*tanh(z/2) to reduce extreme feature magnitudes while preserving frequency ordering. Padding and unseen items retain zero. The existing checkpoint buffer and generated predictor restore the transformed feature directly. Learned embeddings, inverse-frequency scaling, projection, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.

change_summary: Bound the projected training-frequency feature consistently across all four HSTU models, using existing checkpoint and predictor support. Require the supplied GAGC_DATA_DIR environment variable.
